title: Investigate intermittent horizontal display shift/bump
description: User reports occasional subtle rightward bump/shift on the display. Intermittent, gone quickly, cause unknown. Could be LVGL dirty-rect invalidation, display timing, flush callback race, or PSRAM contention. Monitor and investigate when reproducible.
close_reason: Root cause: PSRAM bus contention between LCD DMA, Core 0 JSON, Core 1 LVGL. Applied hsync_back_porch 43â†’50 for timing margin. Full analysis on GH #121.

title: Settings: brightness label missing % suffix on load
